visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium shot shows two Asian men in an indoor kitchen. The man on the left wears a blue t-shirt and a beaded bracelet, gesturing towards the camera with a smile. The man on the right is dressed in a white chef's coat with an apron. Bright studio lighting illuminates the background, which features stainless steel refrigerators and kitchen equipment. (2) A close-up view of a large, circular fruit crepe cake displayed on a wooden board inside a glass showcase. The cake is topped with whipped cream, whole strawberries, and blueberries. The setting is a brightly lit dessert shop interior. (3) The chef uses a black non-stick frying pan over a gas stove, pouring creamy yellow batter and swirling it to form a thin crepe. The other man watches closely. Nearby, various bowls of batter and finished crepes are visible on the metal countertop. (4) Hands-only shot showing a knife peeling the green skin off a kiwi in a single continuous strip. Later, the knife slices the kiwi and strawberries into uniform rounds on a white plastic cutting board. The movements are precise and deliberate. (5) In a top-down view, strawberries are arranged in a ring inside a metal cake mold on a yellow crepe layer. Whipped cream is piped in a spiral over the fruit from a plastic bag. Layers of kiwi, blueberries, and bananas are added sequentially, separated by thin crepes. (6) The chef uses a long metal knife to trim the uneven edges of the assembled cake. He then flips the mold over and lifts it to reveal the layered structure. A final large crepe is draped over the entire cake. (7) Both men stand together holding the finished cake on a wooden tray. The chef feeds a slice to the other man with a fork. They both exhibit joyful facial expressions, smiling broadly and nodding.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 一起來看日本主廚怎麼做水果千層. [Logo]: LINE VOOM. [Slogan]: 那麼大師說的事 - 折田菓舖. (2) [Variety]: 交給我吧!. [Slogan]: 折田將大 日式水果千層蛋糕. (3) [Subtitle]: 煎的時候有沒有什麼訣竅. 動作要快. 我知道你動作很快. [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈. (4) [Subtitle]: 邊邊開始上色. 像這樣子咖啡色. 喔~. (5) [Variety]: 哇. [Subtitle]: (每匙都是固定份量). [Variety]: 成色超漂亮. (6) [Subtitle]: 處理水果. 你都這樣削. 你不用刨刀喔. 這比較快. 哇. 欸很帥耶. 加分耶. (7) [Subtitle]: 每個水果都要切得厚度一樣. 喔~ 這樣會比較平均比較好抹. 對. (8) [Variety]: 側面也會比較漂亮. 喔~. (9) [Subtitle]: 組裝蛋糕. 擺草莓就是對了, 真的不能沒有草莓. (10) [Subtitle]: 你看為什麼中間不擺. 因為切的時候(中間)如果有水果不好切. 會亂七八糟. (11) [Variety]: \一層一層鋪上\. (12) [Subtitle]: 奇異果交疊擺放. 這樣子疊. 對. (13) [Variety]: \一層一層鋪上\. (14) [Subtitle]: 先這樣子. 然後放這邊. 哇. (15) [Variety]: \鋪上一層蛋糕\. \修剪邊邊\. (邊緣)會比較平整, 賣相也比較好. 這個刀很利耶. (16) [Variety]: 蛋糕倒置. 脫模. 抹上鮮奶油. 蓋12吋餅皮. (17) [Subtitle]: 因為最下面如果沒有蛋糕體的話, 那就是皮會黏住在底部, 然後就很難分. (18) [Variety]: 小技巧 有開店的人要注意聽!. 折田將大 日式水果千層蛋糕. (19) [Variety]: \試吃時間\. (老師親餵).
